content: Polkadot XCM: a message *format* (not a transport protocol) using hierarchical MultiLocation addressing expressed relative to the sender (like a relative filesystem path, no fixed root), plus MultiAsset for asset identity, so a parachain-scoped account/asset is addressed by its path within the consensus hierarchy rather than a flat global ID. Actual message delivery is handled by a separate transport (XCMP/relay-chain-routed messaging), XCM only defines the envelope/semantics.
